# Capability and discovery source fixtures

Both target directories are **synthetic, documentation-derived test vectors**, not output captured from an installed AGY binary. Their version labels are the accepted Phase 2 minimum/current qualification targets, 1.1.28 and 1.2.2. They do not establish either version's real help formatting or discovery JSON schema.

The required flag vocabulary and user-line transport follow the [public headless documentation](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless/) inspected on 2026-09-12 and the accepted `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` C01 contract. The [pinned upstream changelog](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/blob/ba985e6b5de2ac8aa09860a154a102831eb7722b/CHANGELOG.md) documents machine-readable models output and the version targets. It does not specify the precise discovery JSON envelope used in these fixtures. The changelog documents `agy models --output-format json` since 1.1.12, below the supported 1.1.28 floor. Production acquisition requests that documented JSON command and has no legacy text fallback. Array/envelope schemas here remain synthetic source candidates for actual native captures in p02t007/p02t008; successful blank output or malformed JSON is a discovery failure, while a valid empty models array withdraws inventory. No fallback model turn is used to test compatibility.

`help.txt` and `version.txt` exercise strict required flags and compatible additive help. `models.json` exercises a minimal required id/name row, additive envelope/metadata, and an unseen opaque ID. P02/P03 must replace or supplement these vectors with exact binary identities and authentic outputs before runtime qualification. Closed stdin on `--version`/`--help` and successful advertised flags establish only non-inference syntax discovery, never single-turn EOF behavior, effective model acknowledgement, native effect absence or supported process containment.
